title: fix(plugin-sharing)!: the write gate judges by id exactly the writes the engine runs by id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSUQWB2j9eHYsRcrCiq1X1C)_

Fixes #33928
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — the docs already state the rule the gate now follows for every predicate write (a predicate `multi: true` update or delete writes only the rows the caller may write: `content/docs/permissions/permissions-matrix.mdx`, `content/docs/permissions/rls.mdx`), and no skill teaches either narrowed shape.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 共享写入闸门按 id 判还是按批量范围判，改为直接采用引擎自己的分派结论：引擎按 id 写的按 id 判，其余一律套用已有的可写行范围。
- **为什么改：** 成员用 `$in` 批量删改自己的记录在私有对象上一律 403，还挡住了 #33699 的批量级联删除；同时补上闸门 id 推断的一处规则缺口。
- **风险与回滚：** 有意的收窄（BREAKING，见下）：`multi: true` 下 where 里标量 id 旁带其它键、或 id 为假值，这两种写法改按批量范围判。按 id 的写法不变。回滚即还原 `engineByIdTarget` 一个函数。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-plugin.ts` 末尾的 `engineByIdTarget`；`operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts` 的门口用例与分派表；changeset 的 BREAKING 段。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts`，预期 `Tests 42 passed (42)`。
- **需要你做的：** 确认这一处收窄（契约复审档）后合并。

> **BREAKING** — a multi-row (`multi: true`) update or delete in either of two shapes, both of which the engine runs as a predicate, is now judged by the bulk write scope instead of by id:
>
> - a `where` that carries a scalar `id` beside another key;
> - an `id` that is falsy (`''` or `0`).
>
> A row the caller may not write is left as it was and the write answers no error, where it answered 403 FORBIDDEN. A row the caller may write only because an application row-level policy widens the sharing scope for it is no longer written by these two shapes, as for every other predicate write. To write such a row, address it by id alone (`where: { id }`, or the payload `id`): that write is judged by id, as before.
>
> ADR-0087 disposition: not required (`no-migration-prescription`). A runtime authorization answer moves; no metadata key, accepted value or stored row changes, so `os migrate meta` has nothing to rewrite. The changeset carries the marker.

## What changes

This closes a rule-level gap in the gate's id inference. The rule:

- **The sharing write gate judges by id exactly the writes the engine runs by id.** The by-id or bulk branch is the engine's own dispatch decision for the write's options: `resolveEngineDeleteDispatch` / `resolveEngineUpdateDispatch`, the helpers the engine's `delete()` / `update()` call on the same bag, imported from `@objectstack/objectql`. A write the engine dispatches by id meets `admitsByIdWrite` exactly as before: the per-verb gate, the ADR-0090 D10 delegator gate, and the deferral to an application row policy.
- **Every other write meets the bulk write scope.** `buildWriteFilter`, plus the delegator's, is ANDed into the AST the engine runs. That covers an `$in` or `$eq` on `id`, the two shapes above, and a call the engine refuses at dispatch. Such a write writes the rows the caller may update or delete, leaves the others as they were, and answers no error, the answer every bulk write already gives (ADR-0111 D3). An owned-only `$in` now lands where it answered 403.
- **A cascade batch** (#33699 / PR #33887, one predicate delete per chunk) meets the same scope. The engine hands any chunk that the scope narrows back to its by-id path. So a child the caller may not delete refuses the cascade with the by-id refusal, and nothing is deleted. The gate carries no flag for it.

## Tests

`src/operator-id-write-gate-33928.test.ts`, 42 tests:

- **Real stack**, 12 pins (ObjectKernel + ObjectQLPlugin over better-sqlite3 + SharingServicePlugin):
  - **by id, unchanged:** an owned row deletes; a not-owned row is refused 403 and stays.
  - **`$in` / `$eq`:**
    - an owned-only `$in` delete lands;
    - a mixed `$in` delete deletes fewer rows and answers no error;
    - an `$in` update writes the editable rows only;
    - an `$eq` delete writes the owned row only.
  - **at the door:**
    - a scalar id beside another predicate key, for delete and update, on the caller's row and on another's;
    - a falsy id (`''`, `0`);
    - `$in: []`;
    - an `$eq` / `$in` update of a row the caller holds only a read share on, which writes nothing;
    - a system-context control that writes every matched row.
  - **cascade:**
    - a child the caller may not delete gives exactly the by-id refusal envelope (code, status, details) and deletes nothing;
    - an owned cascade lands.
- **Dispatch table**, 30 rows, against the middleware itself. It covers every option shape the gate is handed, each with and without `multi`, for update and delete:
  - an id in the payload or in the options, scalar or predicate, alone or combined;
  - falsy ids;
  - calls the engine refuses at dispatch.

  Each row states the branch the engine dispatches it to, by id with its row or bulk. The branch is written out, not computed.

<details><summary>Base against head on a composed stack (plugin-security + plugin-sharing), the narrowing measured</summary>

Real kernel over better-sqlite3, composing `SecurityPlugin` (the platform permission sets plus an app writer set with an RLS update/delete widener) and `SharingServicePlugin`.

- Base `529ed7d9`'s `sharing-plugin.ts` was built into `dist/` (`ablation-dist-preflight --absent` on the head's marker: exit 0), then restored to the HEAD blob and rebuilt (marker present: exit 0).
- The caller is a member with CRUD on both objects. Rows are private (owner-scoped).
- The scratch measurement is not committed.

| shape (`multi: true`) | row | base `529ed7d9` | head |
|---|---|---|---|
| update `{ id, stage }` | the caller's | 1 row written | 1 row written |
| delete `{ id, stage }` | the caller's | 1 row deleted | 1 row deleted |
| update `{ id, stage }` | another's, read-shared to the caller | 403 FORBIDDEN, unchanged | no error, 0 rows |
| delete `{ id, stage }` | another's, read-shared to the caller | 403 FORBIDDEN, stays | no error, 0 rows |
| update `{ id, stage }` | another's, not shared | 403 FORBIDDEN | no error, 0 rows |
| delete `{ id: '' }` / `{ id: 0 }`, update `{ id: '' }` | none | 403 FORBIDDEN | no error, 0 rows |
| update `{ id, stage: 'open' }` | another's, read-shared, admitted only by the app RLS widener | 1 row written | no error, 0 rows |
| delete `{ id, stage: 'open' }` | the same | 1 row deleted | no error, 0 rows |
| update `{ id, stage }` | another's, edit-shared after 5000 earlier edit shares | 1 row written | 1 row written |

The by-id controls answer the same on base and head:

- update `{ where: { id } }` of the caller's row: written;
- the same of a read-shared row: 403 FORBIDDEN;
- the same of the RLS-admitted read-shared row: written;
- the same of the edit-shared row: written.

Where the object's app RLS itself refuses the row, the security gate answers first: 403 on base and head alike, for every shape above.
</details>

<details><summary>Green, ablation and S2 runs (local, under the verify lock, head `185f9d424`)</summary>

Main tree, `origin/main` `86350e125` merged in. The `plugin-security^...` closure was built.

- green: `Tests 42 passed (42)`.
- **Ablation A1**, the gate's own choice of branch, scalar values only: `Tests 21 failed | 21 passed (42)`.
  - red: the scalar-beside-predicate and falsy-id door pins, and table rows 11-29.
- **Ablation A2**, the gate's own choice of branch, any value (the rule before this PR): `Tests 32 failed | 10 passed (42)`.
  - red: the four `$in` / `$eq` pins, the four door pins (scalar beside predicate, falsy id, `$in: []`, read-share update), and table rows 4-7 and 10-29.
  - green: the by-id control, the system-context control, the two cascade pins, and table rows 0-3, 8 and 9.

Each mutation went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor count went 1 to 0, and each run restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty. The file imports `./sharing-plugin.js` from source, so no rebuild is owed.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: `Test Files 75 passed (75)`, `Tests 1567 passed (1567)`.
- `plugin-sharing typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-security test`: `Test Files 270 passed (270)`, `Tests 6718 passed | 45 skipped (6763)`.
- `plugin-security typecheck`: exit 0.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the touched sources: exit 0.

S2's head for #33699 (`616735ceb`), with this change applied and the `plugin-security^...` closure built. `ablation-dist-preflight` confirms that `dist/` carries it.

- #33927's 8 cascade parity pins: `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
- this PR's file: `Tests 42 passed (42)`.

Full dogfood battery on head `185f9d424`, owed by the `(narrowing)` arm. The `@objectstack/dogfood^...` closure was built, then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` ran under the lock: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, `Test Files 467 passed | 3 skipped (470)`, `Tests 3962 passed | 42 skipped (4004)`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `vama-write-path-convergence.test.ts`: a stale comment now states the gate's rule. Comment only.
- A write the engine refuses at dispatch meets the bulk scope in this gate, then the engine's own refusal, instead of a sharing 403 first.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates and declarations</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `185f9d424` derived 72 families. 69 were run locally, each exit 0. `--ran` names the other 3 as unrun; they are declared to CI: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:type-check-debt`.
- With this body as `GITHUB_EVENT_PATH`, each exit 0: `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` (LEVEL AXIS: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` (one declared-breaking changeset, disposition `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), `check-closing-keyword-parity`, and `check-partof-closing-keyword`. `check-closing-target-claim` needs the platform and is left to `pr-body-guards`.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, for the two shapes above. `Metadata-protocol: none`.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` against `origin/main` `ea6de745c` and S2's head `616735ceb`: exit 0 for both.
</details>
